data.street_address: Mall Level -1, Cabot Place, Canary Wharf, London, E14 4QS

description.text:
Greggs is a leading UK food-on-the-go retailer with 2,000 shops nationwide. We continue to specialise in daily fresh shop-made sandwiches and savouries baked off in the shop ovens throughout the day, including our iconic Vegan Sausage Roll. These are further complemented by popular and growing ranges including freshly ground coffee, breakfast, sweet treats, heat to eat sandwiches and Balanced Choice. Greggs’ loyalty scheme, the ‘Greggs App’, is a mobile payment app designed to reward its customers for their loyalty whilst making shopping across its shops more convenient, quicker and easier via Click and Collect. 

Location: Cabot Place
